scope: V3-06 encoded Scene audio-source -> actual target HTML audio consumption; host-owned Chromium, not a replacement BGS player

coverageGap.case: legacy-gap: actual static page loads saved Scene/audio but its Play action does not start media
coverageGap.meaning: Initial surface/load smoke never certified playback. No historical smoke evidence is promoted to audio proof.

implementation.contract: Optional audioProbes identifies registered document/node/component, actual HTML audio selector, viewport, optional activation steps and nonempty playSteps/stopSteps. Existing UI probe operand schema and task/runtime/Review/Repair mechanisms are reused. No database objects, service, render engine, new business stage or native-loop change.
implementation.sourceCoverage: All registered Scene audio-source bindings must have probes, with explicit assetRef, data.volume (0..1) and data.loop, optionally an exact registered encoded data.member. Missing bindings, properties, resources or matching packed bytes remain unverified.
implementation.inputs: Registry, Scene sources, manifest/modules, referenced actual resources and source/build copies; final artifact digest and all file versions rechecked.
implementation.measurement: The game itself plays/stops from real clicks; host never calls its play/pause or resumes its audio graph. Native paused/ended/currentSrc/currentTime/volume/loop/muted/playbackRate/error are observed. A separate captureStream -> observer AudioContext -> Analyser tap measures decoded signal without connecting to output.
implementation.perturbation: Fresh browser contexts observe original, response-only volume change, loop toggle, exact resource replaced by generated silent WAV, then restored original bytes. No source/build/resource file mutation.
implementation.interpretation: Volume and loop fields are consumed as native properties; decoded non-silence becomes silence for the exact registered resource response and returns after restoration. Capture ignores media volume/mute, so native properties are checked separately; no final output/mix or real loop-boundary verdict.
implementation.boundedDriver: Clicks and async media load have driver timeouts; capture context resume has a deadline. Observer graph/tracks/context, driver and owned browser are cleaned up. This is not an agent turn/token cap.
implementation.evidenceCurrency: Existing check versions unchanged; new audio checker has its own version. Actual resource mutation and obsolete checker version invalidate closure.

additionalTests: Review -> failed owner repair cannot close -> actual fixed playback -> directed closure -> obsolete audio checker cannot close
cases.sourceProtection: All consumer matrix cases assert original Scene/audio bytes remain unchanged. Passed cases become noncurrent when the actual registered clip changes. Review/repair writes only its synthetic authorized fixture, not a generated game project.

regression.commandNote: The actual main invocation also named two nonexistent auth paths; they contributed no tests and are not claimed as coverage. The correct auth/session suites were explicitly run separately. Main and supplemental counts are not described as one invocation.
regression.coverage: Actual target audio, UI, font, image and Tilemap browser matrices; owned-driver cancellation; independent debug, CLI with local fake model, Review/Question/Repair, editing, rebuild, version freshness, export, recovery, binding and permissions. Synthetic semantic reports do not establish LLM quality.

typecheck.meaning: Whole server typecheck is not passing; no claim that existing errors were fixed.

trials.note: Initial audio matrix passed 17 tests, then lazy-load/legacy-gap/review integration were added before the final frozen full run. One new optional asset_kind TypeScript dereference was fixed; final V3 diagnostics are zero. Development logs are preserved, not final all-slice evidence.

limitations: Actual encoded runtime matrix uses WAV, not proof that every listed encoding/device is supported.

Only DOM-connected HTML audio with idle -> declared game play -> decoded signal -> declared game pause/stop path. The supported sample is unmuted, unit playbackRate; short one-shots/auto-play/detached Audio and alternative playback semantics need other evidence.
Volume/loop property consumption does not prove final device gain/mute, mix, actual loop wrap, reset/restart, fades, audio aesthetics or listening quality.
Current selected resource consumption, not dynamic assetRef/member switching or complete gameplay-event mapping.
Web Audio/synthesis/spatial audio, full game acceptance, real remote-database + native CLI audio-specific integrated acceptance, paid model/token savings and production deployment remain unverified.
